mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, session_id, request_id, request_hash, status, processing_token, response_json, trace_id, failure_code, created_at, updated_at FROM diet_chat_request WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_chat_request ( user_id, session_id, request_id, request_hash, status, processing_token, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, #{processingToken}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE diet_chat_request SET status = 'PROCESSING', processing_token = #{processingToken}, response_json = NULL, trace_id = NULL, failure_code = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND request_hash = #{requestHash} AND (status = 'FAILED' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < #{staleBefore}))
